newsitem.title: ITALY: UPS four month Italian dispute settled.
newsitem.headline: UPS four month Italian dispute settled.

text.p: UPS on Thursday night reached agreement with national unions over a row over 150 proposed job cuts that has been running since March 6th, a joint government, union and UPS statement said.
The number of staff to be laid off has been reduced to 63 from the initial estimate and UPS has promised 40 of these part-time work. UPS has about 900 employees in Italy.
UPS, the Ministries of Transport and Labour are trying to find work for the remaining 23 workers amongst other transport firms.

Last week UPS was fined 5 million lire ($2,930) and ordered to pay costs by the Milan labour court because of its hostility to unions. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com ($ = 1704 Italian Lire)
